derivation: from the plural of H794 (אֲשֵׁדָה) and H6449 (פִּסְגָּה) with the article interposed; ravines of the Pisgah;
def: Ashdoth-Pisgah, a place east of the Jordan

occurrences.text: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth–pisgah eastward.
And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth–jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth–pisgah:
And Beth–peor, and Ashdoth–pisgah, and Beth–jeshimoth,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
